== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}}
Charles was born on August 1, 1847. He is the son of [[Glasko-3|Isaac Glasko]] and [[Billings-3866|Mary Billings]]. 

He was a blacksmith in Sprague, Connecticut.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasko-3]] is assessed at 93% (proved). Charles F is indexed with Isaac M in 1860 and Isaac in 1870, with compatible 1847 birth and shared blacksmith occupation. Repeated distinctive family placement supports fatherhood, but the held census extracts do not explicitly call him son.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect Charles’s birth/death record parent fields.
